# LAB Plus 1.1.1

- Fixed LAB Plus console settings that appeared in help but were not registered on older DOOM Eternal patches, including 1.1. Native cvar support now covers all 22 supported retail builds.
- All 25 binary settings support the game's standard toggle command, including visibility, filled/outline mode, research recording and the binary speedometer settings. For example:

  ```text
  bind x "toggle labplus_viewer_show"
  ```

- Added preferred `_show` names for the enemy HUD, enemy HP bars, player position, player angles, timers and technique HUD. Their previous names remain synchronized, toggleable aliases.
- Renamed the speedometer settings to `labplus_speedometer_landing_show`, `labplus_speedometer_vertical_show` and `labplus_speedometer_sign_vertical`. Update binds that use the previous speedometer names.
- Console queries show current and factory-default values on one line, followed by the setting description. Saved preferences no longer replace the factory default. Binary value completion offers `0` and `1`.
- Commands requiring arguments now show their description and usage when called without them. `labplus_trigger_set <class>` queries that class's current/default visibility without changing it.
- Use `labplus_commands_list` for the command list. The redundant `labplus_command_list` alias was removed.

See the [Console Commands wiki](https://github.com/IlyaTsyganov/LAB-Plus/wiki/Console-Commands) for the full list, aliases and examples.

Extract the entire Windows x64 archive and run `LABPlus.exe`. Restart DOOM Eternal through the updated LAB Plus to load the new console integration. Requires .NET 10 Desktop Runtime x64 and Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime.
